No archive-news-context row matches this event_id. 394 same-window events share a declared topic. Official-page corroboration coverage is none-reviewed. No interconnection peer met an exact join key.
rationale: The dossier contains one independent source group. Palimpsest treats it as an attributed report, not independent corroboration.

evidence_assessment.conclusion: The dossier contains one independent source group. Palimpsest treats it as an attributed report, not independent corroboration.

limitations: Palimpsest retained feed title, canonical link, publication time, and a bounded excerpt; it did not fetch or semantically evaluate the article body.
Independent-source counts describe publication structure, not the truth, completeness, or intent of the underlying claims.
No current Palimpsest measurement is used in this assessment.
Live-family joins use exact URL or declared topic overlap only; absence of a reading is a coverage gap.
Interconnection peers attach only on a named exact key plus a UTC ±24h window; a miss is not a same-story guess.
A missing official, ledger, wire, or archive reading causes that layer to abstain; the gap is not a zero.
method: Deterministic assessment of one validated newswire event against its independent-source structure, the collector stories explicitly declared by that event, and only the live-family readings supplied to this builder (official-first-seen, public-deletion-ledgers, news-wire-live, undertext, and archive-news-context). Named-key interconnection peers from supplied peer-warehouse readings attach only on an exact host, URL path, extracted term, or ASN plus a UTC calendar-day ±24h window. A peer without an exact key, a silent warehouse, or a warming_up warehouse is skipped. GreatFire, OONI, and CDT counts keep separate denominators and dates. Collector, live-family, and interconnection joins remain topic-surface-only: no article body is fetched, no generative model is used, and no current measurement is represented as article-specific verification, causation, or motive. The v2 brief copies retained metadata into a closed article shape with sentence-level citations. A missing surface abstains.
